title: dedicated-autoscaler-throughput-guarantees-burst-controls-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Lina Chen
description: Motivation: improve Dedicated fleet throughput guarantees and burst controls while giving operators clearer utilization reporting for SLA-driven customers. This PR implements a token-bucket-backed burst controller with per-fleet throughput guarantees, integrates backpressure signaling into the request router, exposes richer utilization metrics for the Console, and adds operator controls to configure smoothing and emergency burst bypass. Changes here aim to reduce tail latency under bursty traffic and make unit economics visible to SRE/product teams. Summary of changes: token-bucket burst controller implemented (configurable refill and burst window), throughput-guarantee enforcement at the fleet-level with soft/hard limits and graceful degradation, request router updates to honor backpressure and route to fallback variants, utilization reporter enhancements (per-fleet p95/p99 utilization, reserved vs used capacity breakdown), new admin API for tuning smoothing/burst parameters, unit and integration tests, and updated Helm values and docs. Performance: in internal canary we observed 18% higher sustained throughput for priority fleets under 2x burst experiments, median latency unchanged, p99 latency reduced by 9% during controlled bursts, and incident runbook shows clearer operator signals. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and migration steps.

release_notes: Enhancement: Dedicated autoscaler now supports token-bucket burst controls and fleet-level throughput guarantees. Operators can tune smoothing, emergency bypass, and view per-fleet utilization (p95/p99). Performance improvements for bursty workloads; see ops docs for migration and tuning recommendations.
notes: Rollout plan: staged canary across two fleets, monitor autoscaler.soft_limit_breached and p99 latency for first 48h, revert knob available. Migration: existing fleets will get default conservative burst window; ops should follow docs to tune for throughput SLAs.
